paragraph: Hasbrouck Heights is a single-family market, 27 sales over six months at a median of $750,000, and the numbers line up cleanly. The sale-to-list ratio is 1.02, 63 percent of homes sold above asking, and the median days on market is 19. That is a real seller's market with plenty of multiple offer situations. Sales ran from $460,000 to $999,999, so the median is the better guide than the range. Monthly counts are thin, two to seven closings, too small to read a trend from any single month, but June and July were the busiest and medians held at $750,000 and $817,500. If the town follows the usual Bergen County seasonal arc, expect closings and medians to ease as fall sets in. Buying here means competing on speed and terms, not waiting for a price cut.
